''See also: [[Dalton Foster Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Dalton Foster is a renowned master gunsmith and a member of the Navigator’s Guild{{!}}Navigator's Guild, serving as the gunner aboard the ship [[The Testament]]. Recognized as a world-class craftsman, his custom firearms are highly prestigious items sought after by the elite. He is a [[Soulbound]], a rare individual capable of [[binding]] himself to his tools; he can manifest floating implements such as hammers, chisels, and tongs through this connection. Physically, he is described as a grizzled, elderly man with untamed gray hair and a thick beard, often seen wearing two pairs of spectacles. Despite his professional success and former wealth, Foster carries significant personal trauma. He was abandoned by his wife and children following a period of upheaval, and he has endured the horrific loss of family members due to the actions of others. He is known for a gruff, scowling temperament and a tendency to forget his aliases, though he remains deeply loyal to his captain, Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten. Throughout various conflicts, Foster has demonstrated both combat proficiency with firearms and a stubborn resilience in the face of danger.}}

chapter 1</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref> A somewhat hermit-like individual, Foster was once a gunsmith who originally made certain pistols and can be found at the gunsmith up the hill.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" /> This old gunner, who uses the false name [[Duster]], is associated with a cannon and has a tendency to shoot those who wake him during the night.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 7</ref> While manning the ship's wheel, he also mans the wheel of the ship.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c28">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 28</ref> Foster visited the main [[Blackwatch]] base alongside Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel and [[Petal]], during which time he fired his [[musket]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 11</ref> He uses both [[shooting-glasses]] and reading-glasses to inspect items like [[musket]] barrels.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c17">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 17</ref><ref <li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster spoke to [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster is a crew member who holds a matchstick.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster is on the ramp of [[The Testament]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster stands behind a cannon wearing [[shooting-glasses]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster is a character who clapped [[Calder]] on the shoulder.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster is standing on the left of [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster uses a sharpened fire poker as a weapon.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster was holding a smoking gun.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster looked through the broken railing at what was in the sea.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster uses [[shooting-glasses]] and a [[musket]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“My gunner, don’t worry about him. He doesn’t care where we go.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Duster,” he said pointedly. Foster had a history of forgetting his false name.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“What just happened?” Foster asked, his voice shaken.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Ready cannons.” “READY CANNONS!” Calder paused for a moment, giving Foster time to comply.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c27" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|His gunner is the Dalton Foster?” “Allegedly.” “Then that’s three Soulbound aboard this ship. At least. It’s not common knowledge, but Foster is a Soulbound.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6" />}}
